subject: Clearwater Kickstart: MAP draft, stakeholders, and kickoff timing
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@clearwaterhealth.com>, Alex Dunne <alex.dunne@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jan 2028 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Clearwater Kickstart: MAP draft, stakeholders, and kickoff timing

Hi Emily / Alex —

Thanks for taking time with us last week. Per our conversation I attached a first-pass mutual action plan (Clearwater_MAP_v0.1.xlsx) that proposes a sequence of milestones, tentative owners and a suggested kickoff cadence. Highlights:

- Proposed kickoff: week of Jan 16 (we're flexible)
- Target go-live window: late Feb (high level)
- First deliverable: integration spec and staging environment access within two weeks of kickoff

Can you confirm:
1) Primary internal stakeholders we should include for technical and procurement coordination?
2) Any hard blackout dates or procurement windows in Jan/Feb?
3) Whether Jan 17 or Jan 18 works for a 60-minute kickoff?

I'll loop in our solutions engineering and CS leads after we get stakeholder confirmation.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

--
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Dunne <alex.dunne@clearwaterhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@clearwaterhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clearwater Kickstart: MAP draft, stakeholders, and kickoff timing

Diego —

Thanks for the draft. Alex and I reviewed it this morning. A few quick notes:

- Jan 17 is tight for our engineering lead (she's traveling). Can we propose Jan 18 or Jan 24?
- Procurement will need to review contract and SLA items before we start any onboarding work. I've CC'd procurement@clearwaterhealth.com — their initial checklist is attached (clearwater_constraints.pdf).
- Our target for production availability is March 1, not late Feb; we have a board milestone the first week of March. That's a hard target.

I'll confirm names for tech, security, and legal by EOD tomorrow. Please keep initial kickoff to agenda items only — we'll save deep design for the second session.

Best,
Emily
Director of Product Operations
Clearwater Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clearwater Kickstart: MAP draft, stakeholders, and kickoff timing

Appreciate the update, Emily. Jan 18 or Jan 24 works from our side — proposing Jan 18 11:00am PST as a tentative slot unless you confirm otherwise. Noted that production target is March 1; we'll treat that as the go-live commitment to plan toward.

I've attached an updated MAP (Clearwater_MAP_v0.2.xlsx) with two changes:
- Revised milestone dates to align toward Mar 1 go-live.
- Added a procurement gating milestone (contract signed) before any work begins.

Action items from Redwood before kickoff:
- Solutions engineer (Vivek) to draft integration checklist and preflight tests
- CS (Grace) to prepare success metrics and onboarding cadence proposal
- Sales (Marissa) to coordinate procurement engagement and pricing summary

Emily — can you confirm the names for security and engineering so we can add them to the MAP and invite them to kickoff?

Thanks,
Diego
--
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@clearwaterhealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clearwater Kickstart: MAP draft, stakeholders, and kickoff timing

Emily / team —

I pulled the high-level milestone roster into the body here so everyone has immediate visibility (also fine to see the attached MAP file for row-level details):

Milestone: Contract execution (sales + procurement)
- Owner: Procurement / Marissa Cole (Redwood)
- Target date: 2028-01-25
- Dependencies: Final SLAs, DPA, PO issuance

Milestone: Staging environment provisioned + creds issued
- Owner: Vivek Kulkarni (SE) / Clearwater IT
- Target date: 2028-02-02
- Dependencies: Contract signed, network allowlist

Milestone: Integration complete (end-to-end smoke)
- Owner: Clearwater Engineering / Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood SE)
- Target date: 2028-02-15
- Dependencies: Staging access, sample dataset, integration spec

Milestone: Adoption pilot / internal validation
- Owner: Grace O'Connor (CS) / Clearwater Ops
- Target date: 2028-02-22
- Dependencies: Integration complete, success criteria agreed

Milestone: Production cutover
- Owner: Clearwater Engineering / Grace O'Connor (CS)
- Target date: 2028-03-01
- Dependencies: Pilot sign-off, runbook complete, rollback plan

Known risks / open items:
- Procurement timelines (Procurement must sign by Jan 25 or downstream dates slip)
- Network access windows: Clearwater has a maintenance blackout Jan 27–28 (Emily to confirm)
- Test dataset readiness — Alex to confirm sample dataset availability by Feb 3

Next steps for kickoff (proposed Jan 18 11:00am PST): 30m agenda for stakeholders, then schedule technical deep-dive w/ Vivek the following week.

Monica
Program Manager | Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Procurement Team <procurement@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Emily Carter <emily.carter@clearwaterhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Clearwater — procurement checklist and DocuSign link

Diego / Marissa —

Attached is Clearwater's procurement checklist (procurement_checklist.pdf). Please review the required contract language items and our standard SLA table. Once the legal redlines are resolved we'll route the document for signature. I've also included a DocuSign link below for the current term sheet; the team expects contract execution by Jan 25 to keep your timeline.

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@clearwaterhealth.com>, Alex Dunne <alex.dunne@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clearwater Kickstart: MAP draft, stakeholders, and kickoff timing

Emily / Alex —

Thanks — this is great alignment. Confirming items we agreed in thread and at a glance next steps:

- Kickoff: Jan 18, 11:00am PST — agenda: introductions, procurement status, timeline confirmation, next technical deep dive scheduling
- Contract: target signoff by Jan 25 (Marissa to coordinate Redwood-side redlines; Emily / procurement to route)
- Milestones: staging by 2028-02-02; integration by 2028-02-15; pilot by 2028-02-22; prod cutover 2028-03-01 (Clearwater target)
- Redwood owners: Vivek (SE) for provisioning/integration; Grace (CS) for pilot and adoption; Marissa (Sales Ops) for procurement coordination

Attachments moved to Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/clearmap/CLR-2028-001/Map-v0.3 (Clean MAP v0.3 has the agreed dates and owner column highlighted). I'll follow up immediately after kickoff with a cadence calendar invite and the first-week checklist.

If anything changes to the procurement timeline please flag immediately — procurement is the critical path for the schedule.

Looking forward to kickoff on the 18th.

Diego
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
